SchoolId.description: The school the request acts in. Checked against the caller's active membership; never trusted on its own.
SchoolId.name: X-School-Id

Error400.description: The request is not valid (unknown or invalid fields, or a missing or malformed X-School-Id).

Error403.description: Not allowed: the caller is not an active member of the school, or lacks the permission, or a record rule refused it. The answer never says which.

Error500.description: Something went wrong on the server.

code.description: Machine-readable; clients localise the text from it.

details.description: Field and rule names only, never the submitted values.

info.description: Multi-tenant school ERP gateway. Every route except the public ones needs a Firebase ID token; school routes also need X-School-Id.
